item.title: Thoughts on Building a Storage System During Model Development
item.description: This article is compiled from part of an internal sharing session I gave. 1. Core Elements of a Storage System 1.1 Security Credentials for object storage buckets, authorization when using storage PVCs, and control over access sources — these are all issues security needs to address. But they are also very easy to overlook, and when something goes wrong it is a big problem.
